reva_host.description: Host or base URL of your Reva tenant, for example `api.example.reva.ai`. Defaults to `api.reva.ai`; a value you set overrides it. Host-only values are called over HTTPS.

auth_token.description: Bearer token Kong presents to Reva Trust Guardian on every evaluation. Find it in the Reva console under Settings. This field is referenceable — store it in a vault rather than inline.

ssl_verify.description: Verify the TLS certificate presented by Reva Trust Guardian. Turn this off only against a test instance with a self-signed certificate.

monitor_mode.description: Evaluate every call and log the verdict, but never block. Use it to see what policy would refuse before you enforce it.

fail_open.description: Proxy the request when Reva Trust Guardian cannot be reached or returns no decision. Off by default, so an outage refuses calls rather than passing them unevaluated.

deny_status.description: HTTP status returned when a call is refused, either by policy or because no decision could be obtained.

deny_message.description: Message returned to the caller in the response body when a call is refused. The specific reason is returned alongside it.

jwt_user_claim.description: JWT claim read from the bearer token to identify the user. Common values are `sub`, `preferred_username` and `cognito:username`.

jwt_groups_claim.description: JWT claim holding the user's group memberships, sent to Reva Trust Guardian as groups a policy can match. Use `roles` for RBAC tokens, `realm_access.roles` for Keycloak, or `cognito:groups` for Cognito.

prompt_key.description: Name of the field that carries the prompt text to Reva. Must match what your policy expects to read.

session_key.description: Where the thread id is read: an HTTP request header of this name first, then the JSON body. Use dots for a nested body field, such as `params.thread_id`. Nothing else is searched. Sent to Reva Trust Guardian on a turn's first call only.

hop_ttl.description: How long, in seconds, the policy keeps a turn open when its first call never finishes. Set it longer than your slowest agent turn.

forward_traceparent.description: Pass the `traceparent` used for the authorization decision on to the upstream service, so one trace id spans the gateway and your backend.

debug.description: Log each decision and the request sent to Reva Trust Guardian at notice level. Use it while tuning policy; leave it off in production.
